paper.title_en: Black hole Near Horizons through the Looking Glass
paper.abstract_en: We show that the near horizon of a generic non-extremal black hole (BH) can be understood in terms of a Carrollian geometry with two null directions, also called a String-Carroll (SC) geometry. The base space of this fibre-bundle structure is a sphere (or a plane for a black brane) and the fibre is the two-dimensional Rindler spacetime. We launch a detailed study of probes in this geometry. We study particle geodesics and scalar fields. The first part of the paper constructs geodesics and probe scalar fields directly in the SC geometry. We then look at a wide class of examples, including the Schwarzschild BH and the Kerr BH in asymptotically flat spacetimes, the BTZ BH and the black brane in AdS spacetimes, as well as Lifshitz black holes and construct the explicit maps to the SC geometry to obtain results specific to each case. These results are reproduced by considering the probe particles and fields in the original BH background and taking the near-horizon limit of the solutions. Our encyclopedia of examples establishes the notion of SC geometries as near-horizon geometries of non-extremal black objects, paving the way for a detailed, intricate future analysis of the quantum aspects of this geometry.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文系统性地建立了非极值黑洞近视界几何与String-Carroll (SC)几何之间的联系，并在多种黑洞背景下验证了探针动力学，具有较高的理论深度和广泛的应用前景。
decision.abstract_zh: 我们证明，一个一般的非极值黑洞（BH）的近视界可以用具有两个零方向的Carrollian几何来理解，这也被称为弦-Carroll（SC）几何。这个纤维丛结构的底空间是一个球面（或对于黑膜是一个平面），纤维是二维Rindler时空。我们对该几何中的探针进行了详细研究。我们研究了粒子测地线和标量场。论文的第一部分直接在SC几何中构造测地线和探针标量场。然后我们考察了一大批例子，包括渐近平坦时空中的Schwarzschild BH和Kerr BH，AdS时空中的BTZ BH和黑膜，以及Lifshitz黑洞，并构造了到SC几何的显式映射，以获得每个具体案例的结果。这些结果也通过在原始BH背景中考虑探针粒子和场并取解的近视界极限来重现。我们的例子百科全书确立了SC几何作为非极值黑洞物体的近视界几何的概念，为未来对该几何量子方面的详细而复杂分析铺平了道路。
